sources.title: ZipNN: Lossless Compression for AI Models - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: We present ZipNN, a lossless compression tailored to neural networks. Somewhat surprisingly, we show that specific lossless compression can gain significant network and storage reduction on popular models, often saving 33% and at times reducing over 50% of the model size.
